= Multiphysics couplings
:page-toclevels: 2
:description: Couplings between two physics interfaces
:page-math: true

Couplings between two physics interfaces. They appear under Multiphysics in the Model Builder once both interfaces exist.

* *Joule Heating* in the Model Wizard adds xref:physics-ec.adoc[Electric Currents] and xref:physics-ht.adoc[Heat Transfer in Solids] with the coupling below.
* *Thermal Stress* in the Model Wizard adds xref:physics-ht.adoc[Heat Transfer in Solids] and xref:physics-solid.adoc[Solid Mechanics] with the coupling below.

[#multiphysics]
== Multiphysics

Home ribbon › Multiphysics

No settings.

[#mp-jh]
== Electromagnetic Heating

Joule heating: resistive losses from Electric Currents act as a heat source in Heat Transfer.

Selection: Domains (all by default) · Home ribbon › Multiphysics

latexmath:[Q_e = \mathbf{J}\cdot\mathbf{E}]

No settings.

[#mp-te]
== Thermal Expansion

Thermal strain from the Heat Transfer temperature field enters Solid Mechanics.

Selection: Domains (all by default) · Home ribbon › Multiphysics

latexmath:[\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_{th} = \alpha(T-T_{ref})\mathbf{I}]

[cols="3,1,1,2,3",options="header",stripes=even]
|===
|Setting |Symbol |Unit |Default |Choices / type
5+h|Model Input
|Coefficient of thermal expansion |α | |From material |From material, User defined
|alpha |α |`+1/K+` |`+0+` |Expression
|Strain reference temperature |T_ref |`+K+` |`+293.15[K]+` |Expression
|===

[#mp-nitf]
== Nonisothermal Flow

Convective heat transport by the Laminar Flow velocity, optionally Boussinesq buoyancy.

Selection: Domains (all by default) · Home ribbon › Multiphysics

latexmath:[\rho C_p\mathbf{u}\cdot\nabla T,\quad \mathbf{F} = -\rho\alpha(T-T_{ref})\mathbf{g}]

[cols="3,1,1,2,3",options="header",stripes=even]

5+h|Buoyancy

|alpha |α |`+1/K+` |`+0+` |Expression
|Reference temperature |T_ref |`+K+` |`+293.15[K]+` |Expression
|===
